gloss: storage medium (for data); data storage device

definitions.gloss: any physical device or material on which digital data can be recorded and later read back, such as a hard disk, SSD, USB flash drive, memory card, CD, or DVD; a storage medium
definitions.explanation: A technical cover term for any physical carrier of digital data. It includes hard disk drives (HDDs), solid-state drives (SSDs), USB memory sticks, SD and microSD cards, CDs, DVDs, Blu-ray discs, magnetic tape, and (historically) floppy disks. The word is common in IT policy documents, product specifications, and news articles about data security. In everyday conversation, Japanese speakers usually use the more specific names like USBメモリ or SDカード.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{記憶|きおく}→記憶：00234_kioku⟧ (memory, recording) + ⟦{媒体|ばいたい}→媒体：12248_baitai⟧ (medium, carrier, vehicle). Literally 'memory medium.' ⟦{媒体|ばいたい}→媒体：12248_baitai⟧ is a productive compound element also used in ⟦{広告|こうこく}{媒体|ばいたい}→広告媒体：16660_koukokubaitai⟧ (advertising medium) and ⟦{情報|じょうほう}→情報：03348_jouhou⟧⟦{媒体|ばいたい}→媒体：12248_baitai⟧ (information medium).

- {記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{保存|ほぞん}→保存：03626_hozon⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save to a storage medium

- ⟦{外部|がいぶ}→外部：00052_gaibu⟧{記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}: external storage medium
- {記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{容量|ようりょう}→容量：04887_youryou⟧: the capacity of a storage medium
- {記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{廃棄|はいき}する→廃棄する：25537_haikisuru⟧: to dispose of a storage medium

TYPICAL EXAMPLES:
- USBメモリ: USB memory stick
- SD⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧ / microSD⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧: SD card, microSD card
- ⟦{外付|そとづ}け→外付け：22099_sotozuke⟧⟦ハードディスク→ハードディスク：06603_haadodisuku⟧: external hard disk
- SSD: solid-state drive
- CD / DVD / ⟦ブルーレイ→ブルーレイ：27074_buruurei⟧: optical discs
- ⟦{磁気|じき}テープ→磁気テープ：23584_jikiteepu⟧: magnetic tape (used for long-term backup)
- フロッピー⟦ディスク→ディスク：24410_disuku⟧: floppy disk (historical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{記録媒体|きろくばいたい}→記録媒体：09281_kirokubaitai⟧: recording medium — a near-synonym, perhaps slightly more common in contexts involving recording (audio, video, photography) rather than general data storage.
- ⟦{記憶装置|きおくそうち}→記憶装置：26493_kiokusouchi⟧: storage device — emphasizes the device hardware (with built-in controller electronics) rather than the bare medium; includes RAM and CPU cache as well as external storage.
- ⟦ストレージ→ストレージ：06959_sutoreeji⟧: storage — an increasingly common loanword in IT contexts, often referring to cloud storage or data storage systems.
- ⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧: media — the loanword, used casually for the same concept (e.g. DVD⟦メディア→メディア：11165_media⟧ = 'DVD media').

USAGE:
In corporate information-security policies, '{記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}' is a standard keyword — the phrase {記憶媒体|きおくばいたい}⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ ('storage media management') refers to the entire set of rules governing how employees can use, transport, and dispose of storage devices that might contain confidential data.

REGISTER:
Formal and technical. Common in written IT and business contexts. In casual speech, Japanese speakers use more specific words: USBメモリ, SD⟦カード→カード：03836_kaado⟧, ⟦ハードディスク→ハードディスク：06603_haadodisuku⟧, etc.
